headline: Lee Minseung gains 4.59 to climb to 37th on ARC-2

sections.text: Lee Minseung moved from 43rd to 37th on ARC-2, gaining 4.59 points to reach 50.42.
The gold places on this board still start at 66.53, so the climb is a move up the table rather than a medal threat for now.
